newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY LEAGUE-EDWARDS LEAVES WIGAN FOR BRONCOS.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY LEAGUE-EDWARDS LEAVES WIGAN FOR BRONCOS.

text.p: British rugby league's most successful player, Shaun Edwards, left Wigan on Thursday to join the London Broncos.
The former Britain scrum-half won every club honour in 13 years of Wigan domination but has taken a pay cut to head south to be nearer his girlfriend and their new-born son.
"I've lost nearly 100,000 pounds over two years in coming here, so it hasn't been for money," said Edwards.
Edwards, 30, approached the Broncos two weeks ago and asked to join his friend and former Wigan team mate Martin Offiah in London.
